beam_direction_body: [0, sin(angle), cos(angle)] with angle in radians
one_way_time: two_way_time_s / 2; assume stationary transducer and reciprocal path during each ping
layers: horizontal piecewise-constant sound speed; no gradient within a layer
interpolation: linear position/tide and shortest-arc unit quaternion interpolation; bracket required except exact sample
output_coordinates: world-NED and depth relative to instantaneous surface
